[[Mamelodi Sundowns F.C.|Mamelodi Sundowns]] won their seventh league title in dominant fashion, finishing 14 points ahead of second-place [[Bidvest Wits F.C.|Bidvest Wits]]. League newcomers [[Jomo Cosmos F.C.|Jomo Cosmos]] dropped into last place for the first time all season in their final game, and were relegated to the [[National First Division]] for the 2016-17
